## Canonical Term Glossary

| Term | Definition (publicly stated) |
|---|---|
| The Palace | AI Governance Operating System; "thinks in systems" |
| Cognitive OS | Meaning, tone, coherence layer between humans and AI |
| Token OS | Generation, memory, structure within LLM |
| CGT | Conversational Game Theory |
| CCGT | Consensus Compositional Game Theory (the game class) |
| Ternary Logic | 0=mystery, 1=objective/true, 2=subjective/false |
| Paraconsistency | Contradiction tolerance without logical explosion |
| Dynamic Nash Equilibrium | Consensus without voting algorithm |
| Parley | 1-on-1 conversational game; co-intelligence pair |
| The Great Game | Scaled collective intelligence game |
| Co-Intelligence | Fundamental building block; paired perspectives |
| TAP | Token Alignment Protocol |
| GRAIL | Global Resolution, Alignment and Inquiry Library |
| PAXIS | AI legal support for migrants/immigrants/citizens |
| GILM | Global Interpreter for Language and Meaning |
| Turn the Nose | Cultural meaning game within GILM |
